purpose: Training-only proof-of-concept data for comparing no-response, point-wise KD, and response-target KD.

observation.perturbation: additive shoulder_lift qpos offset from the frozen variation-specific initial state

target_processing.action_space: physical postprocessed action space before SmolVLA preprocessing
target_processing.pointwise_kd: clip to actuator control range and record clipping
target_processing.response_target: use the already frozen clipped response target and preserve its preclip version for audit
target_processing.normalization: do not normalize in this dataset; SmolVLA checkpoint preprocessor performs MEAN_STD normalization during training

constraints: The held-out -5deg condition must never be generated or stored in this training dataset.
All three target modes must use exactly the same perturbed observations.
No rollout success result may be used while constructing this dataset.
